title: For Guerlain Descendant Patricia de Nicolaï, Perfume Isn’t Just About Legacy — It’s About Freedom
summary: The perfumer, who is expanding her eponymous brand Nicolaï Paris into Neiman Marcus this fall, is ScentXplore's 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award honoree.
